opinions.text:
C. A. 3d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 469 U. S. 1206.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.

Justice Brennan, Justice Marshall, Justice Blackmun, and Justice Stevens would deny this motion.
